entries.effect: the appearance characteristics of a widget annotation as a value object: a settable member per key of an /MK dictionary (PDF 1.7 Table 8.40) and the dictionary itself as -appearanceCharacteristicsKeyValues.  Nothing in the 26.2 SDK hands one out - there is no -[PDFAnnotation appearanceCharacteristics], and grep for appearanceCharacteristics across PDFKit.framework/Headers finds this class's own key-values property and nothing else - so both sides build the object with -init and the comparison is object against object.  Every member is implemented on both sides of every pair, and that is what makes it comparable at all: the host's setter and its getter were measured against each other, so a setter that dropped its value or a getter that invented one would be a difference rather than a key the run had never heard of
entries.source: the host's own PDFKit under macOS in a process that holds no port object, against the port's own objects in a Mac Catalyst process that has a UIColor - tests/backports/host/pdfkit-document/run.sh, three binaries, dladdr proving the two macOS images differ by construction: COMPARED 5329 MISMATCHES 0, of which 72 appearance facts come from the Catalyst side, with twenty-five red controls - one automatic and twenty-four naming a border, appearance or identity key

entries.effect: kPDFWidgetUnknownControl (-1) before anything is set, and the value set after that, read back for every value from -1 to 3.  It is NOT published: -appearanceCharacteristicsKeyValues does not gain a key for it, measured - six members set at once still answer six keys and none of them is this one - so it is an ivar here and not an entry in the dictionary, which is what the host does

entries.effect: the /MK /R value, and the one member with no absent answer: its key is in the dictionary from -init, so a fresh object answers 0 and -appearanceCharacteristicsKeyValues always carries R - measured on a fresh object, on one whose only other member is a caption, and on one whose rotation was set to 0 explicitly.  A negative rotation is kept as set (measured at -90), so the value is not clamped

entries.effect: the /MK /CA value: nil on a fresh object, the string it was set to after that, and nil again once nil is set.
